SILK ROAD by Niche is more than a perfume—it is an invitation to experience luxury through scent. From the first spray, it surrounds you with confidence and presence, making it ideal for individuals who want their fragrance to speak before they do.

A Heart of Rose, Patchouli, and Exotic Saffron

At the heart of SILK ROAD by Niche Eau de Parfum lies a beautifully layered blend of rose, patchouli, and saffron. The rose adds a velvety floral richness that feels sensual and noble, while patchouli introduces earthy depth and balance. This harmonious combination creates a bold yet elegant unisex perfume that transitions effortlessly from day to night. SILK ROAD by Niche is designed for those who enjoy complex fragrances with personality—scents that feel confident, artistic, and unforgettable.

The result is a warm, long-lasting trail that lingers on the skin and leaves a powerful impression wherever you go.

This oud-based unisex fragrance is ideal for evenings, special occasions, or moments when you want to stand out with quiet authority. SILK ROAD by Niche offers impressive longevity and projection, making it a perfect choice for fragrance lovers who seek a refined, niche-inspired scent with true character and presence.
